jobs.title: Sales Representative B2B
jobs.description:
## IN KÜRZE

Als Sales Representative (100%) besteht deine Hauptaufgabe darin, mit Outbound- sowie Inbound Verkaufsaktivitäten neue B2B Kunden zu generieren. Deine Zielgruppe: Arbeitgeber*innen in der Schweiz und Liechtenstein, die für Ihre Mitarbeitenden eine innovative Verpflegung oder Kaffeelösung suchen.

## DEINE VERANTWORTUNGEN

Business Development Opportunities
• Ermittlung von Ausschreibungsmöglichkeiten für die Bürogastronomie in Ihrem jeweiligen Markt

• Persönliches Netzwerk nutzen, um neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu erschliessen

• Einsatz von Kaltakquise und Outbound-Techniken, um die Nachfrage nach FELFEL-Dienstleistungen zu steigern
 Management von Verkaufsprozess

• Kontaktaufnahme mit Interessenten für FELFEL Dienstleistungen und Verwaltung des ersten Kontaktpunkts für eingehende Leads

• Inbound umwandeln, um die gastronomische Erfahrung von FELFEL durch eine Verkostung entweder vor Ort beim Kunden oder in den FELFEL-Büros zu erleben

• Präsentation des FELFEL Service durch ein praktisches gastronomisches Erlebnis, das den Service und das Wertversprechen widerspiegelt
 Verhandlungsgespräche & Abschluss

• Führen von Vertragsverhandlungen, die die Interessen der Kunden mit den Geschäftszielen von FELFEL in Übereinstimmung bringen

• Lösungsorientierter Ansatz für Partnerschaften

DEINE KPI’s
• Gute Konversions Metriken für deine Pipelines

• Anzahl abgeschlossene Deals

• Vertragsabschluss Volumen

## WAS DU MITBRINGST

• Ca. 0-2 Jahre Erfahrung im Verkaufsmanagement, idealerweise in einer verwandten Branche

• Gutes Verständnis des Schweizer Markts (B2B & Konsumverhalten)

• Starke Kommunikation auf Deutsch & Englisch – Französisch ist ein Plus

• Verhandlungssicher und überzeugend im Kundenkontakt

• Fit im Umgang mit CRM-Tools (z. B. HubSpot)

• Du erkennst Entscheidungsträger sofort und weisst, wie du sie richtig ansprichst

• Detailorientiert und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, auch bei administrativen Aufgaben

• Food is your passion! Du bringst spannende Food-Stories mit – und Lust auf mehr

• Ein Führerschein ist erforderlich, da du bis zu 50 % deiner Zeit beim Kunden vor Ort verbringen wirst

• Nichtraucher*in – wir möchten nicht, dass du nach Zigaretten riecht, weder bei der Arbeit noch beim Kundentreffen. Schließlich geht es bei FELFEL um gutes Essen.

• Arbeitsbewilligung oder Schweizer Pass

## WAS WIR BIETEN

• Jede Menge leckeres Essen, nur wenige Schritte von deinem Schreibtisch entfernt - wir erfüllen all deine kulinarischen Wünsche...

• Bester Barista-Kaffee und Tee für das ganze Team dank unserer innovativen Gavetti Kaffeemaschine

• 5 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr

• Pro Jahr gewähren wir zwei ganze Wochen "Work from anywhere" und sorgen damit für Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag

• Wir finanzieren dein Halbtax-Abo, und unterstützen so unsere Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung des ÖV

• Frisch gebackene Eltern erhalten von uns 16 bzw. 3 Wochen voll bezahlte Elternzeit. Wir unterstützen zudem die Rückkehr in den Beruf, indem wir einen grosszügigen finanziellen Beitrag an die Kinderbetreuung bis zum Erreichen des Kindergartenalters leisten

• Tolle Team-Events, wie z.B. unsere bekannten FELFEL Summer-Outings

Wenn das der richtige Job für dich ist, dann bewirb dich jetzt, wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

## Über uns

Bei FELFEL dreht sich alles um gutes Essen und Kaffee am Arbeitsplatz: Wir helfen Schweizer Führungskräften, bessere Gastgeber zu sein.

Mit unserem intelligenten Kühlschrank 'FELFEL' und dem Barista-Kaffee 'Gavetti' ermöglichen wir es Unternehmen, ihre Mitarbeitenden den ganzen Tag über mit erstklassigen, ultra-frischen Speisen und Getränken zu versorgen. Egal ob herzhaft-traditionell, modern-vegan oder proteinreich – unser wöchentlich wechselndes Menü sorgt dafür, dass es für Mitarbeitende immer spannend bleibt ;).

FELFEL ist ein Familienunternehmen, das 2013 gegründet wurde. Heute bedienen wir rund 1000 Standorte in der Schweiz und zählen 150 Mitarbeitende in unseren Büros in Lausanne, Zürich sowie New York.

www.felfel.ch

descriptionByLocale.it:
## IN BREAKDOW

Come rappresentante di vendita, il vostro compito principale è quello di generare nuovi clienti B2B con attività di vendita in uscita e in entrata. Il vostro gruppo target: datori di lavoro in Svizzera e Liechtenstein che stanno cercando una soluzione di cibo o caffè innovativa per i loro dipendenti.

## Le tue responsabilità

Opportunità di sviluppo commerciale
• Identificazione delle opportunità di offerta per la ristorazione in ufficio nel vostro rispettivo mercato

• Utilizzare la rete personale per aprire nuove opportunità di business

• Utilizzo di tecniche di acquisizione a freddo e di uscita per aumentare la domanda di servizi FELFEL
Gestione del processo di vendita

• Contattare gli interessati per i servizi FELFEL e gestire il primo punto di contatto per i lead in arrivo

• Trasforma l’esperienza gastronomica di FELFEL attraverso una degustazione in loco presso la sede del cliente o presso gli uffici FELFEL

• Presentazione del servizio FELFEL attraverso una pratica esperienza gastronomica che riflette la proposizione di servizio e valore
Negoziati e conclusioni

• Condurre trattative contrattuali che allineano gli interessi dei clienti con gli obiettivi aziendali di FELFEL

• Approccio orientato alla soluzione per le partnership

Il tuo KPI
• Buone metriche di conversione per le vostre tubazioni

• Numero di offerte completate

• Volume di conclusione del contratto

## Cosa porti

• Circa 0-2 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle vendite, idealmente in un settore relativo

• Buona comprensione del mercato svizzero (comportamento B2B & consumatore)

• Forte comunicazione in tedesco e inglese – Il francese è un plus

• Negoziare e convincere nel contatto con il cliente

• Si adatta a trattare con strumenti CRM (ad esempio HubSpot)

• Riconosci immediatamente i decisori e sai come affrontarli correttamente

• Metodo di lavoro orientato al dettaglio e strutturato, anche per compiti amministrativi

• Il cibo è la tua passione! Porti emozionanti storie di cibo – e il desiderio di più

• Una licenza del conducente è necessaria perché trascorrerai fino al 50% del tuo tempo presso il sito del cliente

• Non fumatore – non vogliamo che sentiate odore di sigarette, né al lavoro né alle riunioni dei clienti. Dopo tutto, FELFEL è circa il buon cibo.

• Permesso di lavoro o passaporto svizzero

## Cosa offriamo

• Un sacco di cibo delizioso, a pochi passi dalla vostra scrivania - soddisfiamo tutti i vostri desideri culinari...

• Migliore caffè barista e tè per tutta la squadra grazie alla nostra innovativa macchina da caffè Gavetti

• 5 settimane di vacanza all'anno

• Ogni anno concediamo due settimane intere "lavoro da qualsiasi luogo" e quindi forniamo varietà nel lavoro quotidiano

• Finanziamo l'abbonamento a mezza quota e quindi sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti nell'uso dei trasporti pubblici

• I genitori appena cotti ricevono 16 o più da noi. 3 settimane di congedo parentale completamente pagato. Sosteniamo anche il ritorno al lavoro dando un generoso contributo finanziario all'infanzia fino all'età dell'asilo.

• Grandi eventi di squadra, come il nostro noto FELFEL Summer Outings

Se questo è il lavoro giusto per voi, applicare ora, non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione!
descriptionByLocale.en:
## IN BREAKDOWN

As a sales representative, your main task is to generate new B2B customers with outbound and inbound sales activities. Your target group: Employers in Switzerland and Liechtenstein who are looking for an innovative food or coffee solution for their employees.

## Your responsibilities

Business development opportunities
• Identification of tendering opportunities for office catering in your respective market

• Use personal network to open up new business opportunities

• Use of cold acquisition and outbound techniques to increase demand for FELFEL services
Management of sales process

• Contacting interested parties for FELFEL services and managing the first contact point for incoming leads

• Transform inbound to experience FELFEL’s gastronomic experience through a tasting either on site at the customer’s premises or at the FELFEL offices

• Presentation of FELFEL service through a practical gastronomic experience that reflects service and value proposition
Negotiations & Conclusion

• Conducting contract negotiations that align the interests of customers with FELFEL’s business objectives

• Solution-oriented approach for partnerships

Your KPI's
• Good conversion metrics for your pipelines

• Number of completed deals

• Contract conclusion volume

## What you bring

• About 0-2 years of experience in sales management, ideally in a related industry

• Good understanding of the Swiss market (B2B & consumer behaviour)

• Strong communication in German & English – French is a plus

• Negotiating and convincing in customer contact

• Fit in dealing with CRM tools (e.g. HubSpot)

• You recognize decision makers immediately and know how to address them correctly

• Detail-oriented and structured working method, also for administrative tasks

• Food is your passion! You bring exciting food stories – and the desire for more

• A driver’s license is required because you will spend up to 50% of your time at the customer’s site

• Non-smoker – we don’t want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Work permit or Swiss passport

## What we offer

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps from your desk - we fulfill all your culinary desires...

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks of vacation per year

• Every year we grant two whole weeks "Work from anywhere" and thus provide variety in everyday work

• We finance your half-tax subscription and thus support our employees in the use of public transport

• Freshly baked parents receive 16 or more from us. 3 weeks of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until kindergarten age.

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outings

If this is the right job for you, apply now, we look forward to your application!

## À VENIR

En tant que représentant commercial, votre tâche principale est de générer de nouveaux clients B2B avec des activités de vente sortantes et entrantes. Votre groupe cible : les employeurs en Suisse et au Liechtenstein qui recherchent une solution innovante pour leurs employés.

## Vos responsabilités

Possibilités de développement des entreprises
• Identification des possibilités d'appels d'offres pour la restauration de bureaux sur votre marché respectif

• Utiliser un réseau personnel pour ouvrir de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires

• Utilisation de techniques d'acquisition froide et de sortie pour augmenter la demande de services FELFEL
Gestion du processus de vente

• Contacter les parties intéressées pour les services FELFEL et gérer le premier point de contact pour les pistes entrantes

• Transformer l'expérience gastronomique de FELFEL à travers une dégustation sur place dans les locaux du client ou dans les bureaux de FELFEL

• Présentation du service FELFEL par une expérience gastronomique pratique qui reflète la proposition de service et de valeur
Négociations et conclusion

• Mener des négociations contractuelles qui harmonisent les intérêts des clients avec les objectifs commerciaux de FELFEL

• Approche axée sur les solutions pour les partenariats

Votre KPI
• Bonnes mesures de conversion pour vos pipelines

• Nombre de contrats achevés

• Volume de la conclusion du contrat

## Ce que vous apportez

• Environ 0-2 ans d'expérience en gestion des ventes, idéalement dans une industrie liée

• Bonne compréhension du marché suisse (B2B & comportement des consommateurs)

• Une communication forte en allemand et en anglais – le français est un plus

• Négocier et convaincre dans le contact avec le client

• Convient dans le traitement des outils CRM (par exemple HubSpot)

• Vous reconnaissez immédiatement les décideurs et savez comment les traiter correctement

• Méthode de travail détaillée et structurée, également pour les tâches administratives

• La nourriture est votre passion! Vous apportez des histoires culinaires passionnantes – et le désir de plus

• Un permis de conduire est nécessaire car vous passerez jusqu'à 50% de votre temps sur le site du client.

• Non-fumeur – nous ne voulons pas que vous sentiez comme des cigarettes, ni au travail ni lors de réunions de clients. Après tout, FELFEL est une bonne nourriture.

• Permis de travail ou passeport suisse

## Ce que nous offrons

• Beaucoup de délicieux plats, à quelques pas de votre bureau - nous répondons à tous vos désirs culinaires...

• Meilleur café barista et thé pour toute l'équipe grâce à notre machine à café Gavetti innovante

• 5 semaines de vacances par an

• Chaque année nous accordons deux semaines entières "Travailler de n'importe où" et ainsi fournir la variété dans le travail quotidien

• Nous finançons votre abonnement à la demi-taxe et soutenons ainsi nos employés dans l'utilisation des transports publics

• Les parents fraîchement cuits reçoivent 16 ou plus de nous. 3 semaines de congé parental entièrement payé. Nous soutenons également le retour au travail en versant une généreuse contribution financière à la garde des enfants jusqu'à l'âge de la maternelle.

• De grands événements en équipe, comme nos sorties d'été FELFEL bien connues

Si c'est le bon travail pour vous, postulez maintenant, nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature!

## IN SHORT

Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges.

## YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory.

• Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites.

• Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations.

• Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet.

• Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations.

• Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team.

• Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software.

• Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first.

• Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans.

• Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup.

## YOUR PROFILE

• Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework.

• Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait.

• Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin.

• Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous.

• Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code.

• Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers.

• High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end.

• Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus.

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

## OUR BENEFITS

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation

• Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day

• We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund

• New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

• Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

• Migliore caffè barista e tè per tutta la squadra, grazie alla nostra innovativa macchina da caffè Gavetti

• 5 settimane di vacanza all'anno, così come la possibilità di acquistare una settimana extra di vacanza

• Due settimane complete di lavoro da qualsiasi luogo all'anno per portare più varietà al vostro giorno di lavoro

You bring in-depth know-how in electrical engineering, electronics or automation, think analytically and like to tackle yourself? As an Electronics Technician (80-100%) from our workshop in Zurich Binz, you ensure that our networked refrigerators and coffee machines run smoothly. In the 12-member technical team, you are the contact point for tricky cases, grows specifically into refrigeration technology and with your knowledge bring the whole team one step further.

• Systematically document recurring errors and create or improve work instructions (SOPs)

• Advantage: Experience in refrigeration technology

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outings

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss leaders to be better hosts.

Whether hearty-traditional, modern-vegan or protein-rich – our weekly changing menu ensures that it always remains exciting for employees ; .

FELFEL is a family business founded in 2013. Today we serve around 1000 locations in Switzerland and have 150 employees in our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

FELFEL s'intéresse à la bonne nourriture et au café sur le lieu de travail : nous aidons les leaders suisses à être de meilleurs hôtes.

## IN SHORT

• Own and manage a portfolio of 200 clients from post-trial engagement to renewal.

• Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key contacts to manage expectations and overall satisfaction and retention.

• Analyze client needs continuously to optimize their experience and pinpoint cross-sell or upsell opportunities.

• Drive organic growth actively within your segment to maximize account potential and business value.

• Engage proactively with clients flagged during health checks and monitor key metrics to prevent churn proactively.

• Contract negotiations, account reviews, and renewal or termination processes.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with our Acquisition, Product, Operations, and Support teams to ensure a consistent client experience.

• Provide valuable feedback to internal teams based on client insights to continuously improve our offerings and processes.

## YOUR PROFILE

• 2+ years of professional experience in client success, account management, or a similar customer-facing role.

• Proven track record of efficiently managing and growing a large, diverse client portfolio.

• Confident use of CRM tools is necessary

• Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a sense of hospitality

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to connect effectively with various stakeholders.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while building meaningful, value-driven relationships.

• Fluency in French and English

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

## YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

• Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

• Churn Rate

• Portfolio Growth (Cross-sell/Upsell)

• Client Health Score

• Customer Satisfaction (CSAT or NPS)

## OUR BENEFITS

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation

• Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day

• We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund

• New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.

• We encourage ou r employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

• Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

Ready to apply? If this sounds like the perfect role for you, please submit (English or French):

• Your CV & complete documents (references, diplomas)

• A short video introducing yourself and telling us why you are our next Account Manager (max. 1 minute)

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).
